How to Play

Pineapple Head & Flower Man's Guide

🚶 1. Movement & Meeting Flower Man

Use WASD or Arrow Keys (or tap/drag on screen). Walk right to find Flower Man! Once you meet him, he joins you as your loyal companion and can be upgraded with autonomous fruit harvesting and passive pollination!

🍎 2. Fruit Values & Gem Fruits

Walk over fruits to sell them immediately:

  • 🍎 Apple: $5 | 🫐 Blueberry: $10 | 🍓 Strawberry: $15
  • 🍑 Peach: $25 | 🍍 Pineapple: $50
  • ⭐ Golden Stuff: $100! (From the drawing!)
  • 💎 Diamond Fruit: $150! (Sparkling cyan crystal!)
  • ✨ Emerald Fruit: $1,000! (Rare jewel jackpot!)

🧺 3. Continuous Upgrades

Both Pineapple Head and Flower Man have infinite scaling upgrades! Boost walk speed, fruit value multiplier, magnetic aura, rare fruit luck, autonomous foraging, and solar passive $/sec!

🌌 4. Cosmic Evolution: Countries, Worlds & Galaxies

Start by buying parcels in New Hampshire. Then evolve to buy entire Countries (USA, Canada, Brazil...), interplanetary Worlds (Moon, Mars, Saturn...), and vast Galaxies (Milky Way, Andromeda, Multiverse)! Each purchase generates massive passive $/sec income!
